card.name: Words just before a bad outcome
card.fires_on: Short linking words and verbs right before a harmful outcome is named, such as a rash, abuse, accident, bleeding or a failure. The marked word is a grammatical slot, not the outcome itself.

modes.label: Verb leading to a harm
modes.description: A verb or its object slot that is about to name a bad effect or condition.
modes.example: amoxicillin<< develop>> an erythematous skin rash.

modes.label: Linking word before a risk
modes.description: A preposition, article or conjunction that comes right before a risk, liability or negative event.

modes.label: Risky group or setting
modes.description: A noun or sentence end that leads into the problems or consequences.
modes.example: measles demonstrates the problems under-vaccinated<< populations>> can pose
